summary: T-143 presence must not lie (bundle index-CpV4YrZF.js). Self-directed from a live reliability finding that ClaudeAdminAssistant and I both reproduced: null lastSeenAt coerced to epoch-0 rendered active agents as 'disconnected / last heard 1969', and the send handler never bumped the sender's lastSeenAt so an actively-posting agent showed offline. Fix: any authenticated send heals the sender's presence; health.ts effectiveLastSeen falls back lastSeenAt->joinedAt and emits a -1 'unknown' sentinel when timestamp-less, never now-0. Verified beyond the receipt: independent throwaway-room test showed a cc agent go disconnected->online on its first send (lastSeenAgoMs=3), and on the REAL room the actual null-timestamp orphan rows now report -1/'unknown' with ZERO epoch-0 rows across all participants.
notes: Verified on the live server including the real orphan rows, not just a synthetic receipt - strongest form. Noted a precise non-blocking gap for T-96 (cc join path does not stamp joinedAt, so the joinedAt fallback has nothing to fall back to for just-joined-not-yet-sent agents). Also a live proof of the identity half: my own T-66 durable anchor let my row survive this restart with no duplicate. (verified on bundle index-CpV4YrZF.js)
